$comment: The plugin recipe: every artifact a complete plugin needs, each with the wizard step that writes it, its commit layer, how it is made, the declaration fields it reads (JSON pointers into the declaration schema), its template, its paths, the rule that says when it is owed, and its CHECKER: the name of one function in tools/plugin-recipe.mjs and that function's arguments, reading the real files. Plus the LAWS every plugin keeps. Read by tools/omx-new-plugin.mjs (the derived fields, the commit plan, the checklist) and by tools/plugin-recipe.mjs (`make completeness`: every plugin has every owed artifact and keeps every law). Adding a required artifact is one entry here: the wizard then writes it and the completeness test requires it of every plugin.

rules.panel: the declaration carries a panel block, or the plugin is generated from its instance face (which draws every parameter when it declares none); a hand-written plugin with no panel yet owes no MOD GUI
rules.byReference: the pinned omx-contract is at or past contract.byReferenceSince, the release that carries plugin parameters by reference; before it, a declaration still types its travels
rules.instance: the declaration says "binding": "instance": tools/gen.mjs generates the plugin's binding, identity test, faces and Makefile from it and omx-dsp's instance face

steps.identity: the plugin's declaration: stem, kernel, CLAP id, LV2 URI, parameters by reference, panel
steps.kernel: the kernels the parameters reference: their files in omx-contract at the pin (by the kernel recipe in omx-contract and omx-dsp when one is new), and the pin
steps.generate: the files tools/gen.mjs and tools/modgui-gen.mjs write from the declaration
steps.faces: the build and the CLAP and LV2 faces, plain C over omx-dsp, and their binding to the kernel
steps.tests: the parameter test and the kernel-identity test
steps.packaging: the RPM and DEB file lists, the metapackage's description and CI's installed-file checks
steps.docs: the README's catalogue row and manual section

layers.what: the declarations: the plugin's own declaration
layers.message: {name}: its declaration, parameters by reference to the {kernel} kernel

layers.what: the kernel the declaration references: the omx-contract pin
layers.message: omx-contract {contractRelease}: the {kernel} kernel the plugins reference

layers.what: every file generated from the declaration
layers.message: {name}: the generated parameter header and LV2 description
{name}: CLAP and LV2 faces in plain C over omx-dsp's {kernel} kernel

layers.what: what ships and installs the plugin: the packages and their checks
the tests of the faces against the kernel

artifacts.what: the plugin's ONE declaration, valid against the schema, its identity unique among the plugins

each kernel's file in omx-contract at the pinned release, which the parameters reference (by the kernel recipe in omx-contract and omx-dsp when it is new); the pin moves to the release that carries them
the parameter table both faces read, generated and fresh
the LV2 bundle's manifest and plugin description, generated and fresh
the MOD GUI of the LV2 bundle, generated from the panel block and fresh
for a binding: instance plugin, the rest of its folder as tools/gen.mjs writes it now from the declaration and omx-dsp's instance face: the Makefile, both faces, the binding and the identity test
the plugin's build: all, test, gen, check, install and clean, naming the declaration's identity; for a binding: instance plugin, generated by tools/gen.mjs (instance-files holds it fresh)
the CLAP face, plain C, reading the generated table and exporting clap_entry; for a binding: instance plugin, generated by tools/gen.mjs (instance-files holds it fresh)
the LV2 face, plain C, reading the generated table and exporting lv2_descriptor; for a binding: instance plugin, generated by tools/gen.mjs (instance-files holds it fresh)

the faces reach omx-dsp's kernel: the plugin's sources include <omxdsp/fx/omx_<kernel>.h> (or its instance core) for each kernel it declares, and none is still the wizard's stub; for a binding: instance plugin, generated by tools/gen.mjs (instance-files holds it fresh)
the parameter test: make test compares the built CLAP face's parameters with the declaration; for a binding: instance plugin, generated by tools/gen.mjs (instance-files holds it fresh)

the kernel-identity test: an oracle comparing both faces with omx-dsp's kernel called directly, run by make test, not the wizard's stub; for a binding: instance plugin, generated by tools/gen.mjs (instance-files holds it fresh)
the RPM %files lists name the plugin's .clap and .lv2 bundle: generated regions (tools/gen.mjs) of packaging/omx-plugins.spec
the DEB install lists cover the plugin's .clap and .lv2 bundle
the packages' descriptions name the effect (its noun): the RPM's %description and the DEB metapackage's Description
CI's package checks expect the plugin's installed files: the generated short-name list (tools/gen.mjs) of .github/workflows/ci.yml
the README catalogue's row, from the declaration's summary or description: a generated region (tools/gen.mjs)
the README's section, from the declaration's manual or its parameters: a generated region (tools/gen.mjs)

laws.what: plain C: no C++ source or header in the plugin
no DPF: no DISTRHO header, macro or plugin-info file
the kernel comes from omx-dsp: no engine source included, and no function omx-dsp defines defined again in the plugin

every parameter has a ref into omx-contract and retypes no travel, or is `own` (a switch of the plugin's face, the strip's stage order) with its travel typed; every ref resolves in its kernel's file at the pin (a composite names each parameter's kernel)
